integrity: The self-contained standard-library checker verifies 105 pairwise distances, 56 and 1024 faces at the nontrivial scales, exact mod-two ranks, and all 120 signed character comparisons.
scientific_limitations: Only the shortest-path graph metric on the fifteen line-graph vertices is treated.
The seven-class irreducible decomposition is over rational coefficients, not an integral lattice decomposition.
The radius-two nonequivariant sphere count follows from previously known antipodal graph data; the contribution is the explicit full rational equivariant persistent homology.
No equivariant wedge splitting or independent mathematical validation is asserted.
Unindexed prior equivalent symmetry calculations may exist.
title: Equivariant Vietoris–Rips persistence of the Petersen line graph
